2) 60 min technical deep-dive (post-handshake) with your infra lead + our infra/SE team to sort access and deployment model.

- Mon Oct 5 — 1:00–2:00 PM PT (technical deep-dive)
- Wed Oct 7 — 11:00–11:45 AM PT (exec handshake) — alternate

If you can suggest a slot that works for the CTO and VP, we’ll lock it. I’ve attached a one-page pilot scope and a short pre-demo checklist (helps speed the tech call).

Also: quick ask for the exec call — can you include the CTO and the head of infra (Tom Bishop?) and confirm whether they prefer a live demo or a short slide walkthrough first.

Thanks — happy to coordinate invites once you confirm a window.
